# Spotter

A free, open-source macOS menu bar app that watches your Dart and Flutter projects and tells you
which dependencies have new releases. Written in Swift. MIT license.

- Repository: https://github.com/spotter-demo/spotter
- Domain: spotter-demo.dev
- Latest release: 1.2.0, a notarized DMG on GitHub Releases
- macOS 14 or later
- Makes no network calls except to pub.dev. No accounts, no analytics.
- Screenshot: assets/menu.png (real, 1600x1000)
